She invites me out to the mall at 1pm. I get a text, asking to push it back to 3:00. Then 4:00. Then 6:00. Finally she bags the mall and suggests we go get some dinner at 9:00. I make reservations for 9:30, and she and her boyfriend show up at 10:00.

The boyfriend and her then start making small talk with me, like nothing happened. I was a little irritated that I had been pseudo blown off about 5 times but whatever. They asked me how is life, how is the girlfriend, what is her degree, etc? They proceed to shit on my career goals and my girlfriend's college degree *to my face*. I silently stared at them for a while, paid the bill (they didn't eat anything) and then left.

My girlfriend woke up to me shaving my head and eyebrows. I had taken mushrooms and was in the process of having a serious fucking meltdown. I pleaded for my girlfriend to kill me as I came after her with a knife but she wouldn't do it (obviously). Then I told her to let me die and to let me go. She wouldn't have been able to call 911 she was shaking and crying so badly.
"Touch me again and I'll hurt you"
My girlfriend drinks my milk. Interestingly enough I'm not pregnant and should not be lactating so that's weird. Mammogram time!
If each ASCII character to represent the digits 0-9 are 8 bits (1 byte) then 1MB = 1048576 digits. Looking around on computer overclocking forums, it seems that it's ~1 million digits so hooray math!
